item.title: Multi-Node, Multi-Disk MinIO Cluster Performance Testing Under Different Erasure Code Configurations
item.description: 1. Erasure Code Configuration The default erasure parity configuration is as follows: Erasure Set Size Default Parity (EC:M) 1 EC:0 2-3 EC:1 4-5 EC:2 6 - 7 EC:3 8 - 16 EC:4 The maximum parity is ERASURE_SET_SIZE/2, meaning the number of parity blocks cannot exceed the number of data blocks.
